gates.evidence: Round-2 receipt set: 4 new trailer receipts (trailer-furyroad, trailer-shining1980, trailer-hungergames2026, trailer-mrirrelevant). rig/verify_receipts.py on the full corpus: 'checked 23 receipts — ALL DETERMINISTIC GATES PASS' (completeness, shot arithmetic sum(lens)=duration ±2% with lens=cuts+1, cuts-monotonic, loudness-consistency).
media-containment: creative-study/.gitignore covers .media/ and *.mp4; `git ls-files creative-study` lists no media — only JSON receipts, MD docs, and rig scripts.

sheet-reads (llm gate): 4 trailer sheets read at judge time — Fury Road (no credit cards, one long atmospheric open, title at 91%), The Shining 1980 (five typed credit cards, canonical 'presents/based on/from director/date/in theaters' grammar), Hunger Games 2026 (mid-trailer Lionsgate card at 23s, type-on title building from 67%, logo 95%), Mr. Irrelevant ('true story' card at 22%, title 96%). All frames read as distinct coherent shots of their named sources.

New derived metric is receipt-reproducible: the per-act escalation curve (act3/act1 median-shot ratio) computed from cuts.shot.lens_s + probe.duration_s alone — no external data — giving 0.35 / 0.37 / 0.76 / 0.61 across the four trailers (median 0.49).
